name: scholar-mcp
description: Multi-source academic search, citation traversal, paper text and figures, and a persistent research library.

data_dir.title: Scholar data directory
data_dir.description: Local PDFs, SQLite library, snapshots, and vault data.

s2_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
s2_api_key.description: Optional key for higher Semantic Scholar limits and snippet search.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: Optional key for OpenAlex search and citation traversal.

dashscope_api_key.title: DashScope reranker API key
dashscope_api_key.description: Optional key for the Qwen reranker; local fallback remains available.

dashscope_base_url.title: Alibaba workspace base URL
dashscope_base_url.description: Optional workspace API host (https://...) or /api/v1 base; empty keeps the Beijing shared endpoint.

rerank_model.title: Reranker model
rerank_model.description: Alibaba model (default qwen3-rerank), or the model on your custom endpoint.

rerank_url.title: Custom rerank endpoint
rerank_url.description: Optional full rerank endpoint for another provider or local model; overrides Alibaba routing.

rerank_api_key.title: Custom reranker API key
rerank_api_key.description: Credential for the custom endpoint only; never inherits the Alibaba key.
